objects.taxonomy_description: Adult castrated bovine measuring 140-180 cm at withers weighing 400-900 kg. Body massive and muscular with short dense coat in white, brown, black, or pied coloration. Head broad with wide muzzle. Horns curved laterally and upward (if not dehorned). Eyes large and dark with wide field of vision. Ears large and mobile. Neck thick and muscular with prominent dewlap. Body deep-chested with strong back. Legs sturdy with cloven hooves. Tail long with terminal tuft. objects.taxonomy_description: Swift leporid mammal measuring 45-70 cm body length with elongated body and powerful hind limbs. Fur dense in brown, gray, or seasonal white coloration. Ears exceptionally long (10-15 cm) with black tips. Hind legs massively elongated with muscular thighs enabling rapid leaping at speeds exceeding 60 km/h. Forelegs shorter. Tail short. Timid behavior with cryptic resting posture. Larger than rabbit with longer ears and legs.
